comment: Kurayami inflicts the Blindness debuff. If the effect fails to land,
recast will be delayed based on the configured retry duration.
when: hasSpell('Kurayami: San', 'Kurayami: Ni', 'Kurayami: Ichi') and canUseSpell(spell)
(findUsableItem('Toolbag (Sai)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1)) or \
(findUsableItem('Toolbag (Cho)') and freeInventorySlots() > 1 and useItem(me) and wait(1))
